content.summary: Current visual coverage is v4 pages 1–3; my earlier v4 inspections cover pages 4–8. The integrated preview retains readable hierarchy and source mathematics across all eight pages, with the previously disclosed raw-markup presentation limits.

checks.scope: Title, prior work, methods, and general theorem layout
checks.method: Verified this round's hashes and preview binding, checked page hashes, then viewed pages 1–3 against the frozen Markdown.
checks.observation: The title and section headings are distinct, and headings remain with following text. Page 2 ends after the complete corollary; page 3 continues with declaration locators. The rank-zero qualification, degree-square formulas, equivalence, and three-star subtraction retain their source notation without visible clipping. Dollar delimiters, TeX commands, backticks, and emphasis markers remain visible: this supports source readability, not polished mathematical typesetting, semantic PDF tagging, or accessibility conformance.
